f.title: Submit serious domestic ADRs from HCPs on the Agency MAH form by e-mail within 15 days
f.statement: The PV responsible person submits data on every serious adverse reaction, or suspicion thereof, received from a health professional in Bosnia and Herzegovina, by completing the Agency's adverse reaction report form for MAHs (published on the Agency website) and sending it to the Agency's ADR e-mail box at the latest 15 days from receipt.
f.clause: Obligations of the PV responsible person (page 2)
f.applicability: Serious ADRs reported by health professionals in BiH
f.systems: Agency ADR form for MAHs; e-mail

rows.actor: Person responsible for pharmacovigilance appointed by the marketing authorisation holder in BiH
rows.deadline: At the latest 15 days from receipt
rows.quote: dostavljanje podatka o svakom ozbiljnom neželjenom djelovanju lijeka ili sumnji na njega, dobijenog od zdravstvenog radnika sa teritorije Bosne i Hercegovine; predmetni podatak se Agenciji dostavlja popunjavanjem obrasca za prijavu neželjene reakcije na lijek (obrazac namjenjen nosiocima dozvole i objavljen na službenoj web prezentaciji Agencije)
rows.location: Obligations of the PV responsible person (page 2)
rows.review_note: Review: the 15-day limit follows the Agency's e-mail address in the source, which cannot be quoted (address removed); deadline proved by the same sentence's continuation 'najkasnije 15 dana od primitka istog'. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: submission of data on every serious adverse reaction to a medicine or suspicion thereof, received from a health professional from the territory of Bosnia and Herzegovina; the data are submitted to the Agency by completing the adverse drug reaction report form (form intended for marketing authorisation holders and published on the Agency's official website)

deadline_rule.applies_to: serious ADRs from health professionals in BiH

f.title: Submit unexpected serious domestic ADRs from HCPs within 1 day
f.statement: The PV responsible person submits data on every unexpected serious adverse reaction, or suspicion thereof, received from a health professional in BiH, on the Agency's MAH adverse reaction form via the Agency's ADR e-mail box, at the latest 1 day from the day of receipt.
f.clause: Obligations of the PV responsible person (page 2)
f.applicability: Unexpected serious ADRs reported by health professionals in BiH
f.systems: Agency ADR form for MAHs; e-mail

rows.actor: Person responsible for pharmacovigilance appointed by the marketing authorisation holder in BiH
rows.deadline: At the latest 1 day from the day of receipt
rows.quote: dostavljanje podatka o svakom neočekivanom ozbiljnom neželjenom djelovanju lijeka ili sumnji na njega, dobijenog od zdravstvenog radnika sa teritorije Bosne i Hercegovine;
rows.location: Obligations of the PV responsible person (page 2)
rows.review_note: Review: 1-day limit stated after the e-mail address ('najkasnije 1 dan od dana primitka istog'); consistent with Art 7(c) of the 2012 rulebook ('jedan dan'). Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: submission of data on every unexpected serious adverse reaction to a medicine or suspicion thereof, received from a health professional from the territory of Bosnia and Herzegovina;

deadline_rule.clock_start: najkasnije 1 dan od dana primitka istog
deadline_rule.applies_to: unexpected serious ADRs from health professionals in BiH

f.title: Submit unexpected serious ADRs from outside BiH as a line listing or CIOMS form within 15 days
f.statement: Data on every unexpected serious adverse reaction recorded outside BiH are submitted to the Agency by e-mail as a line listing or, at the PV responsible person's discretion, on a CIOMS form, at the latest 15 days from receipt.
f.clause: Obligations of the PV responsible person (page 2)
f.applicability: Unexpected serious ADRs recorded outside BiH
f.systems: CIOMS I form; line listing; e-mail

rows.actor: Person responsible for pharmacovigilance appointed by the marketing authorisation holder in BiH
rows.deadline: At the latest 15 days from receipt
rows.quote: dostavlja Agenciji kao line-listing ili, po procjeni odgovorne osobe za farmakovigilansu, na CIOMS obrascu najkasnije 15 dana od primitka istog.
rows.location: Obligations of the PV responsible person (page 2)
rows.review_note: Review: Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: is submitted to the Agency as a line listing or, at the discretion of the person responsible for pharmacovigilance, on the CIOMS form at the latest 15 days from receipt thereof.

deadline_rule.applies_to: unexpected serious ADRs recorded outside BiH

f.title: Report all other ADRs and adverse events, any origin, in the PSUR or PBRER
f.statement: The Agency is informed in writing of all other adverse reactions/adverse events or suspicions thereof, regardless of geographical origin or source, by submitting a PSUR or a PBRER, unless the PV responsible person judges otherwise.
f.clause: Obligations of the PV responsible person (page 2)
f.exceptions: Unless the PV responsible person judges otherwise.

rows.actor: Person responsible for pharmacovigilance appointed by the marketing authorisation holder in BiH
rows.quote: obavještavanje se vrši u pismenoj formi - podnošenjem periodičnog izvještaja o bezbjednosti lijeka (PSUR) ili podnošenjem periodičnog izvještaja o ocjeni odnosa koriost-rizik (PBRER) osim ukoliko odgovorna osoba za farmakovigilansu procjeni drugačije.
rows.location: Obligations of the PV responsible person (page 2)
rows.review_note: Review: Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: notification is made in writing - by submitting a periodic safety update report (PSUR) or by submitting a periodic benefit-risk evaluation report (PBRER), unless the person responsible for pharmacovigilance assesses otherwise.

f.title: Report safety data from MAH-sponsored post-marketing studies in the PSUR or PBRER
f.statement: The Agency is informed of collected medicine safety data obtained from post-marketing studies sponsored by the manufacturer or the MAH by submitting a PSUR or PBRER.
f.clause: Obligations of the PV responsible person (page 3)

rows.actor: Person responsible for pharmacovigilance appointed by the marketing authorisation holder in BiH
rows.quote: obavještavanje Agencije o prikupljenim podacima o bzbjednosti lijeka, koji su dobijeni postmarketinškim ispitivanjima koje sponzoriše proizvođač ili nosilac dozvole za stavljanje lijeka u promet podnošenjem periodičnog izvještaja o bezbjednosti lijeka (PSUR) ili podnošenjem periodičnog izvještaja o ocjeni odnosa koriost-rizik (PBRER).
rows.location: Obligations of the PV responsible person (page 3)
rows.review_note: Review: Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: informing the Agency of the collected data on medicine safety obtained from post-marketing studies sponsored by the manufacturer or the marketing authorisation holder, by submitting a periodic safety update report (PSUR) or a periodic benefit-risk evaluation report (PBRER).

f.title: Report post-authorisation PV evaluations relevant to benefit-risk in the PSUR or PBRER
f.statement: The Agency is informed of the evaluation of post-authorisation pharmacovigilance data relevant to the benefit-risk assessment, including new scientific and technical knowledge, by submitting a PSUR or PBRER.
f.clause: Obligations of the PV responsible person (page 3)

rows.actor: Person responsible for pharmacovigilance appointed by the marketing authorisation holder in BiH
rows.quote: obavještavanje Agencije o ocjeni farmakovigilantnih podataka u periodu poslije dobijanja dozvole o stavljanju lijeka u promet (postmarketinški period) a koji su od značaja za ocjenu odnosa koristi i rizika i obuhvataju nova znanstveno-tehnička saznanja podnošenjem periodičnog izvještaja o bezbjednosti lijeka (PSUR) ili podnošenjem periodičnog izvještaja o ocjeni odnosa koriost-rizik (PBRER).
rows.location: Obligations of the PV responsible person (page 3)
rows.review_note: Review: Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: informing the Agency of the evaluation of pharmacovigilance data in the period after obtaining the marketing authorisation (post-marketing period) which are relevant to the assessment of the benefit-risk balance and include new scientific-technical knowledge, by submitting a periodic safety update report (PSUR) or a periodic benefit-risk evaluation report (PBRER).

f.title: Monitor national and international scientific journals for new safety information
f.statement: To follow the latest information on the safety profile of medicines authorised in BiH, the PV responsible person should use scientific journals of national and international importance as literature sources.

rows.actor: Person responsible for pharmacovigilance appointed by the marketing authorisation holder in BiH
rows.quote: Literaturni izvori koje odgovorna osoba za farmakovigilnasu u BiH treba koristiti u cilju praćenja najnovijih informacija o bezbjedonosnom profilu lijeka odobrenog za tržište BiH, su naučni časopisi nacionalnog i međunarodnog značaja.
rows.review_note: Review: level follows 'treba' (should). Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: The literature sources which the person responsible for pharmacovigilance in BiH should use to follow the latest information on the safety profile of a medicine authorised for the BiH market are scientific journals of national and international importance.

f.title: Provide additional information, CIOMS forms or clarifications on Agency request
f.statement: The Agency reserves the right to ask the PV responsible person for additional information, CIOMS forms or clarifications on submitted cases where needed to understand the situation better or to improve the safe use of medicines in BiH; the PV responsible person provides them.

rows.actor: Person responsible for pharmacovigilance appointed by the marketing authorisation holder in BiH
rows.quote: Agencija zadržava pravo da od odgovorne osobe za farmakovigilansu zatraži i dodatne informacije, CIOMS obrasce ili pojašnjenja u vezi sa dostavljenim slučajevima, ukoliko se procijeni da je to neophodno za bolje razumijevanje situacije ili za unapređenje bezbjednosti primjene lijekova u BiH.
rows.review_note: Review: the duty to respond is implied by the Agency's stated right; the 2012 rulebook Art 7(i) makes complete and timely answers mandatory. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: The Agency reserves the right to request from the person responsible for pharmacovigilance additional information, CIOMS forms or clarifications regarding the submitted cases, if it is assessed that this is necessary for a better understanding of the situation or for improving the safety of use of medicines in BiH.
